_comment: Which mxm-fx-oldify parameters fill the collection control roles: none yet.
No role the standard declares is a quantity this effect has. Mix is how much of the aged
sound is heard, which is not how much delay (fx.delay), reverb (fx.reverb), curve stack
(fx.dynamics) or chorus (fx.chorus_mix) is heard; Output is an effect's level, not an
instrument's (voice.output); Drive feeds the medium, not a filter (filter.drive); Wow and
Flutter are a tape's speed, not a delay line's wobble (fx.delay_wobble). Roles of its own
are a collection-wide change to the standard (docs/MXM_CONTROL_MAP.md in mxm-kit).
